ai_summary: Alkem Laboratories reported healthy 10.9% YoY revenue growth in Q1FY27, driven by strong domestic performance (outperforming the IPM) and robust non-US international sales. However, this positive top-line growth was materially impacted by a significant **21.7% YoY decline in Net Profit** and compressed EBITDA margins, indicating substantial profitability challenges. A key red flag is the "Official Action Indicated (OAI)" status issued for its Daman formulations facility, which could pose ongoing regulatory and operational risks.
